## 3. The session's decisive scientific finding (T-1, restated in one line)

The ≤2x sigprofiler parity row is **not an engine deficit**: the faces
run a documented-defaults 4000-fit extraction chain on 96×1 single-sample
cells while the yardstick runs one NNLS assignment solve; the accounting
identity over the sealed floor table leaves W = 10.96x after the banked
K and T factors, and the measured kernel-time ceiling (faer ≤1.31x;
hand-SIMD 1.02x; L1-L5 1.223x step-core) is a rounding error against it.
The bit-identity wall never bound; **arithmetic did**. Consequence:
CAMPAIGN-R's closing premise needs a user-owned definition ruling
(re-scoped yardstick / frontier re-basing / retirement), and T-3's lane
is protocol-side only.
